Groove Grid

A digital twin of the Launchpad, whose 64 pads are the cells of a MAP‑Elites archive: each holds the best groove found for its number of hits and its syncopation.

▶ Watch the demo

  1. 1stChoose or tap a rhythm
  2. 2ndListen to a few pads
  3. 3rdPick the one you like

No Bluetooth earphones. They delay the sound, so your taps land late. Use wired headphones or the laptop speakers.

    On the page: Space bar to tap, Enter to build, double-click a pad to pick it.
